thread:
Anna: Async mid-quarter OKR milestone check-in — drop a one-line status for your milestone (shipped/slipped/on track), owner, blockers, and next step. I’ll compile and share with execs EOD. Please include links to PRs/tickets. /cc @Mike @Sara

Mike: Runtime v2 rollout — PARTIALLY shipped. Owner: Mike. Canary at 60% traffic, baseline lat looks good but we’re seeing tail spikes on a subset of mesa hosts. Blocker: kernel driver regression on some dedicated hosts. Next: revert the driver override on affected hosts and open infra ticket. PR: #3492

Sara: Embeddings cache project — ON TRACK. Owner: Sara. Canary warm, cache hit rate 78% in canary. Blocker: none. Next: finish canary ramp and ship docs. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/120 :tada:

Tom: Autoscaler policy rollout — SLIPPED. Owner: Tom. CI e2e failing (race in scale-up tests). Blocker: flaky `scale_up_race` test. Next: revert newest autoscale config, patch test, re-run. CI job: https://ci/redwood/auto-237

Priya: Observability retention increase (Dedicated) — ON TRACK. Owner: Priya. Blocker: budget approval pending from finance. Next: pinged finance lead @Liz for signoff. Finance thread: https://threads/fin/approve-retention

Ben: E2E test coverage for runtime v2 — PARTIAL. Owner: Ben. Blocker: flaky sequence-length timing in batching tests (non-deterministic). Next: add deterministic seeds and isolate timing windows, retry. Test PR incoming.

Anna: Quick notes: Mike — can you paste the infra ticket link here when created? Tom — estimate ETA on the autoscaler fix (days)? If anyone truly ships today, mark as "shipped" + timestamp. I’ll escalate kernel driver to infra and set a 9am quick sync tomorrow if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for runtime v2 at 2026-03-16T15:02:41Z — 60% - no errors > 5m.

Mike: Infra ticket created: INF-2123 https://jira/redwood/INF-2123. Linked PR 3492.

Sara: Docs link again: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/120 — minor copy fixes, ready for merge after canary.

Tom: ETA for autoscaler patch ~ 3 days (patch + CI rework). Will post PR when flaky test is isolated.

Priya: Finance pinged @Liz — said she’ll review later today. If approved we can complete retention rollout tomorrow.

Anna: Thanks everyone — I’ll assemble this and share with execs EOD. If anything slips further, DM me directly. :thumbsup:
